requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without any authentication headers. Verify that the response returns a list of approved reports suitable for display on a map, ensuring anonymous user names are hidden and public statistics are visible.
rationale: Validates the core public-facing functionality for unregistered users as per domain rules regarding public map view.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
prompt: First, create a new report via POST /reports using an authenticated technical office staff session. Then, execute PUT /reports/{id}/mainteiner to assign an external maintainer ID to the created report. Verify the assignment is successful and the report state updates correctly.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a new report via POST /reports to obtain a valid report ID for assignment.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{id} if it was successfully created; otherwise, verify no resource exists.
rationale: Tests the specific workflow of assigning external maintainers to reports, a critical step in the intervention process.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member updates report statuses.
prompt: Authenticate as a technical office staff member. Execute PUT /reports/{id}/status to transition a report from 'Pending Approval' to 'Assigned'. Verify the state change and that the correct technical office is assigned based on the problem category.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a new report via POST /reports to obtain a valid report ID for status update.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{id} if it was successfully created; otherwise, verify no resource exists.
rationale: Tests the transition from pending to assigned state, ensuring the system correctly routes reports to technical offices.

requirement_summary: Municipal administrator configures automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category.
prompt: Authenticate as a municipal administrator. Execute POST /reports/{id}/auto-assign-maintainer to configure automatic assignment for a specific report category. Verify that the configuration is saved and applies to future reports of that category.
setup_needed: Ensure no existing auto-assignment rules conflict with the new configuration for the target category.
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
rationale: Tests the administrative capability to configure automatic assignment rules, ensuring faster interventions as per requirements.

requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
prompt: Execute a happy path registration for a citizen. Provide a unique username, valid email, and password. Verify that the response indicates successful registration and returns a verification code or token as expected by domain rules.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the primary entry point for citizen access (PT01) and ensures the system generates necessary verification artifacts.
